entries.subject: Physical scale
entries.finding: 1 ± 0.15 km, radar-derived diameter. JPL SBDB lists the diameter 1.0 ± 0.15 km with the reference Benner et al. (2002), Icarus 158, 379-388, from Arecibo and Goldstone radar. The radar diameter is transferred to the light-curve mesh volume; it is not a fit to this mesh.
